summary: Code quality is strong: proper PowerShell idioms (Set-StrictMode, try-catch, ErrorActionPreference), GitHub Actions output export correct, workflow uses least-privilege permissions and pinned actions (actions/checkout@v4). Function documentation comprehensive. However, deliverable is critically incomplete: test file (tests/SemanticVersionBumper.Tests.ps1) referenced in workflow but not provided; no fixture files (VERSION, commits.log); act-result.txt artifact missing; no actionlint validation proof; no evidence of act runs. Task explicitly requires TDD (tests first), Pester tests passing, act pipeline validation—none demonstrated.
